q: What is the last date to submit the semester fee?
a: The last date is 15 November. A late fine of Rs. 500 applies after that.

q: How can I contact the exam office?
a: Visit Room 12, Admin Block, or email exams@university.edu (Mon-Fri, 9am-4pm).

q: How do I apply for a transcript?
a: Fill the transcript form at the registrar office and pay Rs. 300. It is ready in 3 working days.

q: What is the minimum attendance required?
a: Students need at least 75% attendance to sit in the final exam.
